item.title: I Hope You’re Using Data Protection
item.description: Read I Hope You’re Using Data Protection I was in a meeting where a new database was being discussed. We were talking about entering customers' details into this database, and there was a bit of to and fro about how we'd get their permission to enter their details. Coworker: "We wouldn't necessarily need their permission." Read I Hope You’re Using Data Protection

item.title: Signings Of The Times
item.description: Read Signings Of The Times Me: "Ma'am, you need to sign the back of the card." Customer: "I'm not going to do that. I don't want anyone to steal my signature." Read Signings Of The Times

item.title: Keeping The Remote Control
item.description: Read Keeping The Remote Control Me: "My husband quit his job and found a new one here. I sold my house. I moved almost 1,000 miles to keep my job because that was a requirement of the position." Manager: "Let’s table this conversation until you’ve calmed down." Read Keeping The Remote Control

item.title: Schrödinger’s Photo Order
item.description: Read Schrödinger’s Photo Order Customer: "Well, if you're just going to throw them away, then I might as well take them." Me: *Confused.* "So, you do want to pay for them? Customer: "No! Seriously, pay attention! I'm not paying for them, but if you're just going to throw them away anyway, then I'll take them for free." Read Schrödinger’s Photo Order

item.title: Can YOU Find the Stolen Merchandise?
item.description: Read Can YOU Find the Stolen Merchandise? The backpack is heavy. Way too heavy. I unzip it and flip it upside down. A pile of toys spills out across the counter. Still in customer-service mode, I look up at her. Me: "Did you want to get all of these too?" Read Can YOU Find the Stolen Merchandise?
